methodology: Individual-sense review: model-assisted semantic curation by the coding assistant. Each assignment was selected using the exact English Wiktionary translation heading and part of speech in expanded-lexicon.json, with practical relevance to the named activity. Candidate headwords were only used for discovery; homonymous meanings were inspected separately and only the listed concept IDs receive these categories. Headword, meaning and POS are reproduced unchanged for provenance and validation. All selected concepts have a Turkish form and at least eight language forms in the source; no translation or missing form was invented. Shared actions receive multiple categories only where their exact sense is useful in each activity. Existing source attribution, license and per-concept evidence remain in expanded-lexicon.json. This is dictionary-derived semantic classification, not native-speaker review, proficiency grading or verification of every translation.
